column1: # Term glossary for the translators. One row per concept; the language columns hold the word used in
# that catalog, `note` carries a rule that must not be broken. A new language adds a column, filled
# from the English column first and reviewed before the bulk translation starts.
# The source language is Hungarian; `en` is the pivot of the pipeline. Keep the rows in this order:
# the workout library, the ride log and the About dialog all lean on these words.

column8: a rider on a bicycle, never cavaleiro / jinete / Reiter / Pferd
the activity; the verb is pedalar
a recorded ride in the ride log
a finished ride, the summary's subject
structured workout, also the library entry
never "rota", which is a route in the sense of a shipping route
the FTMS trainer; "trainer" alone may stay
the replay of an earlier ride
short labels; prose may say frequência cardíaca
the number of turns per minute
a free ride, without a workout
European Portuguese, not configurações; the Settings dialog
the review page; the review page
Bluetooth scan; a text search is pesquisa / Suche
